claims.evidence: Subjective marketing term; no brand/model markings are legible in the photo to assess build quality.
Witness confirms a multi-speed rear cassette and derailleur are visible, but exact speed count cannot be determined from the photo.
Photo 0 shows a front suspension fork with yellow lowers, consistent with a shock-absorbing fork.

risks.risk: Gear count may be lower than advertised (e.g. 7/14/21 speed instead of 18)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the shifter markings or a count of chainring/cassette teeth combinations
risks.if_unproven: price as base multi-speed bicycle without premium for claimed 18-speed

risks.risk: Suspension fork may be cosmetic/non-functional (common on cheap bikes)
risks.proof: Short video clip showing the fork compressing under hand pressure
risks.if_unproven: price as rigid fork equivalent, no suspension premium

risks.risk: Brake and gear functionality unknown (cables, derailleur adjustment)
risks.proof: Video clip of wheels spinning with brakes applied and gears shifting through range
risks.if_unproven: price as needing full mechanical service

risks.risk: Frame cracks, rust, or dents not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, underside of down tube, and rear dropouts
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetic-risk frame, worst case minor structural damage

risks.risk: Tire/tube condition and wheel trueness unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tire sidewalls and a clip of wheel spinning to check wobble

risks.risk: No brand/model identified, so authenticity and parts quality unverifiable
risks.proof: Photo of head tube badge or frame decal/serial number

risks.risk: Accessories (pedals, lights, lock) may not be included
risks.proof: Full-bike photo showing pedals and any accessories clearly
risks.if_unproven: price as bare bicycle without accessories

proof_requests: Clear photo of shifter/gear display showing speed count
Video of fork compressing under pressure
Video of wheels spinning with brakes and gears being tested
Close-up photos of frame joints and dropouts for cracks/rust
Photo of tire sidewall and wheel spin test for trueness
Photo of head tube badge or serial number for brand/model
Full bike photo showing included accessories
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a multi-speed bicycle with a front suspension fork, so it can be priced at worst case pending proof of speed count, suspension function, and mechanical/frame condition.
